reports.title: Antero Midstream Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial and Operating Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance Update
section: Antero Midstream is updating its 2026 guidance to reflect receipt of the Clearwater litigation proceeds. Based on the $377 million of litigation proceeds, net of the impact of interest expense and current income tax expense, the Company is increasing 2026 Adjusted Free Cash Flow before and after dividends guidance by $370 million. All other guidance ranges not referenced below remain unchanged.
The following is a summary of Antero Midstream’s updated 2026 guidance ($ in millions, except per share amounts):

Twelve Months Ended December 31, 2026 | Change vs. Prior Guidance
Low | High | (At midpoint)
Net Income | 765 | 815 | 280
Interest Expense | 200 | 220 | (10
Current Income Tax Expense | 10 | 20 | 15
Adjusted Free Cash Flow Before Dividends | 1,125 | 1,185 | 370
Adjusted Free Cash Flow After Dividends | 700 | 760 | 370
